summary: Pivot to building "Genz App": an Uber/Bolt-style marketplace that connects clients with nearby service professionals in Kenya (especially Gen Z), with role-based logins, industry-based search, map-based location visibility, pricing/rates display, provider verification, ratings, and customer care access.
architectural_notes: Role-based access control for three user types: provider, client, technical/back-office.
Google Maps integration required for real-time/approximate location display and proximity-based discovery.
Provider onboarding includes document upload and back-office verification workflow.
Marketplace linking model: clients browse providers by category and see rates before engaging.
Reputation system: 5-star ratings after job completion.
In-app customer care contact entry points (e.g., call/SMS/WhatsApp).
Client-side should not reveal provider contact details until provider confirms availability and payment is successful (gated disclosure).
Add M-Pesa STK Push/API payment integration for connection fee collection and payout routing to configured destination.
Update primary phone support contact to +254 723 169 783 (keep payout destination 0791955725).
Add marketing/brand assets support: a designed background theme and an in-app/hosted muted animated demo video for showcasing app flows.
known_issues: Build/deploy failed due to an internal configuration issue (Caffeine).
Uploaded logo appears unclear/blurry in the app UI; needs a clearer 512x512 render for the 40x40 rounded header icon.
Support/contact list UI (Help/Support contacts) was not created/visible as expected.
Landing page CTAs/draft section (e.g., “Get Started”) currently appear unresponsive because they are not wired to any action/navigation.
App still not displaying for the user; likely related to missing/broken logo asset at `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` causing header image load failure.

## Edit Images

existing_features.title: Create a minimal, working app shell that loads successfully and displays a landing page confirming the app is set up.
Add a simple navigation layout (header + main content area) that can scale to additional pages later.
Implement a coherent visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, component styling) and apply it consistently across the landing page and navigation. Do not use a blue/purple color scheme.

Rebrand the existing app shell UI to “Genz App” and replace the current landing-page copy with an English, Kenya-focused marketplace description for connecting clients with nearby service professionals (e.g., cleaners, gardeners, dog groomers, plumbers, chefs, electricians).

Implement role-based onboarding and login flow with three user categories: Service Provider, Service Seeker (client), and Technical/Back-office team, using Internet Identity for authentication and backend-stored role selection/assignment.
Create service industries/categories and enable clients to browse and search categories to discover nearby providers offering the selected service.

Add provider profiles that include offered categories, a displayed rate/price, and an approximate location (latitude/longitude) for proximity-based discovery; allow providers to create/update their profile.
Add a map-based location view using Google Maps that displays client and provider locations (with graceful fallback when a Google Maps API key is not configured).

Implement a back-office verification workflow: providers can upload verification documents; Technical/Back-office users can review submissions and mark providers as Verified/Rejected with an optional note; verification status is visible to clients.

Implement a minimal job/linking flow and 5-star rating system: clients can “link/hire” a provider at the displayed rate, mark the job as completed, and submit a 1–5 star rating; provider average rating is displayed in search results and provider details.

Add always-available customer care contact information in the app UI (e.g., header/footer and a persistent “Help/Support” entry) with clearly labeled phone lines; text must be in English and easy to find while using the app.
Generate and use custom static brand images for the Genz App (logo + category icons) and render them in the UI from frontend/public/assets/generated (no backend image serving).

Replace the current Genz App logo asset with the user-uploaded logo image so the header brand icon uses the uploaded logo while keeping the existing asset path `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`. Ensure the resulting logo file is a 512x512 PNG and looks good when rendered as a 40x40 image with rounded corners in the header.
Replace the placeholder support phone number in the in-app Support UI with the user-provided phone support contact: +254 723169783, and ensure it is rendered as a tappable/clickable tel: link.
Ensure a visible "Customer Support" contact list exists in the Support UI (Support drawer) and is accessible from both the header "Support" entry and the footer "Customer Support" entry.
Fix the Genz App logo clarity so it looks sharp when rendered as a 40x40 rounded icon in the header while keeping the asset path `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`.

Add a new "Featured Providers" section within the main Landing page content that displays dummy provider profiles for multiple services (at minimum: Architects, Cleaners, Plumbers, Gardeners) and shows a sample rating for each profile.

Increase the visual prominence of the Genz App logo in the header while keeping the existing logo asset path `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`, ensuring the logo remains sharp (not blurry) and does not break the header layout on mobile and desktop.

Update the Landing Page "Featured Providers" dummy provider list to remove the Architect entry and replace it with a Chef entry, including complete dummy profile details (name, category, rate, rating, review count, location, verified flag) consistent with the existing featured provider cards.

Create and apply a fancy, brand-consistent background treatment for the app (at minimum the unauthenticated Landing page), using a generated static background image stored in `frontend/public/assets/generated`, and ensure content remains readable and accessible (sufficient contrast, no interference with cards/text).

Add a muted animated explainer/demo video asset that shows how Genz App works (onboarding, browsing services, map view, hiring/linking, and support), store it as a static file in the frontend public assets, and embed it on the Landing page in a clearly labeled “How it works” / “Demo” section with standard playback controls and a poster image.

Wire up the Landing page hero CTAs so clicks feel immediately responsive: (1) “Get Started” must trigger the real onboarding flow by prompting Internet Identity login if the user is logged out, then proceeding to the existing role-selection onboarding screen; (2) “Learn More” must smoothly scroll/focus to the “See How It Works” (demo video) section.

Make the “See How It Works” demo video section feel more realistic and live by adding interactive controls around the existing video: include a prominent “Play Demo” control overlay (while paused) and a small set of clickable chapter/highlight buttons (e.g., Onboarding, Browse Services, Map View, Hiring/Linking, Support) that seek the video to relevant timestamps and then play.

Add realistic profile images for the dummy/featured provider accounts and render them in the Featured Providers cards (Landing page) as visible avatars/headshots (not generic icons). Images must be stored as static assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and referenced by filename in the Featured Providers section.

Create a new Landing page section that shows platform adoption stats: number of clients onboard and number of service providers onboard, with an animated count-up/countdown-style effect when the section becomes visible.

Add a provider “preview” step before opening the full Provider Detail view that shows (a) the provider’s engagement status (Engaged / Not Engaged) and (b) the provider’s current/approximate location with an option to view it on Google Maps.

Gate access to full provider profile information—especially the contacts section—behind a successful connection-fee payment equal to 10% of the provider’s displayed rate, and prompt the client to pay before they can view full details.

Add an M-Pesa payment initiation + verification workflow for the 10% connection fee, integrated via a configurable M-Pesa API (STK Push style), and use the verification result to unlock provider details.
After a provider is unlocked, expose communication options: a clickable call action (tel: link) and an in-app messaging interface for client↔provider communication.

Remove the Landing page “How it works”/demo area by deleting the embedded demo video section from the Landing page and updating the hero CTA behavior so there is no longer any scroll-to-demo interaction.

Update the “Join Our Growing Community” stats section to show realistic adoption numbers by enforcing a minimum display of over 200,000 clients and about 150,000 service providers, while still using backend values if they exceed those thresholds.

Add provider profile picture upload during provider profile setup/editing, storing the uploaded image in the backend and displaying it in provider-facing and client-facing provider views where profile pictures are shown.

Add separate provider document upload sections for (1) Academic qualification documents and (2) Certificate of Good Conduct, and make these documents available to back-office users for review as part of the provider verification workflow.

Create a testimonials section using dummy testimonials tied to service providers (including the existing dummy/featured provider identities), and render it as a new Landing page section for social proof.

Update the Landing page “Join Our Growing Community” stats section so it always displays a realistic minimum that is strictly greater than 200,000 for “Clients Onboard” and approximately 150,000 for “Service Providers Onboard”, while still displaying backend-provided totals whenever they exceed those minimum thresholds.

Regenerate the existing Genz App logo image at `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` so it is a crisp, sharp 512×512 PNG that still looks clear when rendered as a small rounded app icon in the header (e.g., ~40×40 to ~80×80 CSS pixels).

Replace the existing static logo asset at `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` with a regenerated, crisp 512×512 PNG derived from the user-uploaded image `Gemini_Generated_Image_g3cec6g3cec6g3ce__1_-removebg-preview.png`, ensuring the header logo no longer shows a broken-image icon and remains sharp when rendered at small sizes (approximately 40×40 to 80×80 CSS pixels) with rounded corners on light backgrounds.

Replace the current Genz App logo by regenerating the existing static logo asset at `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` with a new proposed logo design that borrows key visual ideas from the user’s original logo (overall concept, recognizable motifs, and brand feel) while still being an original, clean, modern mark appropriate for a Kenyan services marketplace.

Verify and adjust (if needed) the header logo rendering so the new logo remains visually clear and well-aligned across breakpoints without changing the logo asset path and without breaking the header layout on mobile and desktop.

new_feature_requests.summary: Define three main login/user categories: Service Providers, Service Seekers (clients), and Technical/Back-office team.
Create service industries/categories (e.g., cleaning, gardening, dog grooming, plumbing, chef, electrician) that users can browse/search to find providers.
Enable location-based discovery and display of client/provider locations using Google Maps integration.
Show provider rates/pricing to clients for linking/hiring a specific service provider.
Back-office verification flow for service providers to upload documents, and for the technical team to review/verify (especially for specialized services).
Post-job client rating system using 5-star ratings for service providers.
Add user-friendly customer care/contact lines accessible within the app.
Hide service provider contact details from clients until a connection is approved (availability confirmation) and any required fee is paid.
Add provider availability confirmation step: when a client requests to contact a provider, the system asks the provider to confirm availability before sharing contact details.
Implement a 10% connection fee charged to the client (based on the provider’s quoted rate) before releasing provider contact details.
Integrate M-Pesa payments (STK Push/API) to automatically collect the 10% connection fee and route funds to a configured payout destination (bank/M-Pesa).
Add admin-configurable payout and primary support contact settings (provided payout: 0791955725; main contact: 0795532919).
Use the user-provided uploaded image as the Genz App logo in the UI (replace generated logo asset).
Add dummy provider profiles on the main page (e.g., architects, cleaners, plumbers, gardeners) showing sample ratings for preview/demo purposes.
Adjust the Genz App logo usage in the UI to render it intelligently larger (improve visual prominence while keeping it crisp).
Update the dummy/featured provider profiles on the landing page: remove the Architect profile, replace it with a Chef profile, and create the Chef dummy profile details.
Create a fancier/more visually engaging background for the app (landing page/UI) to improve branding and presentation.

Wire up the Landing page “Get Started” (and any currently non-responsive draft/demo CTAs) to a real action flow (e.g., role selection → login/onboarding) so clicks provide immediate, visible response.
Add realistic profile images/avatars for the dummy/featured provider accounts (use generated static assets and render them in the provider cards).
Create a landing-page stats section showing number of clients and service providers onboard, with an animated count-up/countdown-style effect.

Add a backend query API to return platform counts for the Landing page stats section (total client profiles count and total provider profiles count) in a way that works for anonymous users viewing the Landing page.
Show provider engagement/availability status (e.g., Engaged vs Not Engaged) on the provider preview/listing before viewing the full profile.
Allow clients to view a provider’s current/approximate location on Google Maps from the preview/listing before unlocking the full profile.
Gate/unlock the full provider profile details (especially contacts) behind a successful M-Pesa payment of a 10% connection fee based on the provider’s rate.
Add client↔provider communication options after unlock: clickable calling (tel link/online calling entry point) and an in-app messaging/chat platform.
Implement a backend-derived provider engagement status that clients can see in provider preview/listing, based on whether the provider currently has an active (requested or in-progress) job.
During provider onboarding/profile setup, add specific document upload sections for academic qualification documents and Certificate of Good Conduct for back-office review as part of verification.
Add a provider profile picture upload/selection section during provider onboarding/profile setup so provider accounts look more real.
Create a testimonials section for service providers (including dummy accounts/testimonials) to display social proof in the app/landing experience.
Update the “Join Our Growing Community” stats section to show realistic adoption numbers beyond 200,000 clients and around 150,000 service providers (enforce minimum display thresholds).
Remove the current uploaded/logo asset and create a new proposed Genz App logo inspired by (borrowing ideas from) the user’s original logo; update the app to use the new logo asset.
